title: The 2.5D Paper Stack
idiom: layered paper-cut / woodblock print — Lotte Reiniger silhouette cutout aesthetic, layers of black-ink paper at staggered depths, hand-cut edges
hero_prompt: Wide darkened backdrop in the register of a Japanese mokuhanga woodblock print — three or four sheets of stark black-ink paper stacked with visible air between them, each sheet cut cleanly along its own brushed black line, the topmost sheet curling slightly as if beginning to pull free into space; a single figure in silhouette mid-step between the flat stack and an implied third dimension just beyond its edge; warm paper-fiber texture throughout; no letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial
icon_prompt: Bold high-contrast square emblem — a cross-section view of three stacked rectangles in black ink on off-white paper, each offset slightly to show depth, the top layer's edge cut into a sharp diagonal suggesting motion; thick brushed outlines, no fine linework, survives at 24px; no letters, numerals, words, labels
